description: Attestor token is derivable from anchor token by applying a known OCR confusion pattern -> -1.5 applied to attestor reading score

triggering.notes: OCR error model en.rn_as_m: 'rn'->m confusion. 'morning'.replace('rn','m')='moming'. Attestor token 'moming' is derivable from anchor token 'morning' by this confusion -> modifier fires.

near_miss.near_miss_reason: 'morbing' is NOT derivable from 'morning' by any confusion in the en OCR error model. Checking all model entries: 'morning'.replace('rn','m')='moming' (not 'morbing'); 'morning'.replace('cl','d') -> no 'cl' in 'morning'; etc. No pattern matches -> modifier does not fire.
